updates.text: Active for the first time this season. Stone's packet dresses him in place of Hoskins for additional linebacker and coverage-unit depth, citing Pittsburgh's run game, Stanford's injury and Posluszny's late projected clearance; Westhoff checked him in the active coverage rotation in Friday's kicking period. Nothing charged to him on the recorded reps.
updates.source: Source: [Week 5 record](career/2014/Regular_Season/Games/Week_05/output.md). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

short.text: Todd Davis is an undrafted rookie from Sacramento State who was active for the first time against Pittsburgh and has played {{2014.regular.special_teams_snaps:words}} snaps on special teams. He was a productive inside linebacker in college, plays downhill and has value on the coverage units. His range in coverage is the question.

transactions.text: Signed a three-year contract with Jacksonville as an undrafted rookie
